problem_statement: The devicetree.h API has no way to count, at compile time, the number of nodes on a bus that are nested deeper than one level under a bus controller, or to exclude nodes behind a child bus controller, or to filter by status. DT_CHILD_NUM only counts direct children, so it cannot describe the real number of on-bus peripherals when the tree contains intermediate container/structural nodes or nodes that are not actual devices. The expected behaviour is that new macros DT_DESCENDANT_NUM_ON_BUS(node_id, bus), DT_DESCENDANT_NUM_ON_BUS_STATUS_OKAY(node_id, bus), and their DT_INST_ variants report the number of descendant nodes whose binding declares that bus as their on-bus value, walking through non-bus container nodes, counting a child that is itself a bus controller for the parent bus, excluding devices behind that child bus, and (for the *_STATUS_OKAY variants) only counting nodes whose status is okay. For the supplied test devicetree the controller reports 6 descendants / 4 status-okay and the child bus extender reports 2 / 1.
